title: eef-european-heavyweight-championship

won.source: Won a 15-man tournament at The Grand European.

lost.source: Title is vacant by the December PPV; no document shows how or when it was vacated.

note: The fed's first attested European Heavyweight Champion.

title: eef-european-heavyweight-championship

won.source: Won a twelve-man battle royal at Survival of the Fittest.

lost.source: No later document survives in the held record.

note: Won a twelve-man battle royal at Survival of the Fittest to fill the vacant title.

title: eef-german-championship

won.source: Won a bye into the Grand European semi-finals after winning the Royal Rumble, then the German Championship.

lost.source: A rival claimant bills himself the 'Real GERMAN CHAMPION' by December; the disputed lineage is carried, not resolved.

note: Disputed lineage: carried, not resolved (see the December rival-claimant document).

title: eef-tag-team-championship

won.source: Won the Grand European's own tag team tournament final over the Italian Stallions.

lost.source: No later document survives in the held record.

note: The fed's first attested Tag Team Champions.
